title: Courtroom Turmoil
next_chapter_hook: The Xuanwu Sect emissary clutched his swollen cheek as he retreated from the court. Before departing, he cast one final glance at the composed figure atop the platform, a deep-seated hatred flickering in his eyes—the fuse for a sect-level conflict had been quietly ignited.

text.content: The explosions outside the imperial city shook the Golden Luang Hall three times, fine dust raining down from the glazed tiles. The Xuanwu Sect emissary's accusations abruptly stopped as he spun to look outside—heavy smoke was billowing from the direction of the East Huamen Gate, dyeing half the sky an ominous orange-red. "What disturbance is this?" the old emperor on the dragon throne demanded sternly. The ministers in the hall exchanged uncertain glances, but Chen Ji remained steadily behind the Crown Prince, a faint, meaningful smile playing on his lips—the fuse he had personally lit.

dialogue.content: "Your Majesty, your subject just heard unusual commotion from the direction of East Huamen Gate. I fear assassins may have infiltrated." Chen Ji's voice was unhurried and measured as he slightly bowed. "Your subject is unwell and should not disturb Your Majesty's sacred attention at this critical moment. However, the honored emissary from Xuanwu Sect has traveled a great distance..." He pivoted, his gaze sweeping toward the ashen-faced emissary. "I wonder if he was affected?"

text.content: The Xuanwu Sect emissary felt a chill run through him—the "incident" had come too suspiciously. He had arranged everything meticulously; how could there be a last-minute complication? Suppressing his unease, he said heavily: "A minor commotion is of no consequence. Since the Grand Tutor is unwell, his spirit must be lacking. Why not let this emissary present the ironclad evidence directly to His Majesty for sacred judgment—" Before he could finish, another commotion erupted outside the hall.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji coughed lightly, covering his face with his sleeve, his voice weak yet carrying a thread of concern: "The honored emissary need not be impatient. Let your subject send someone to investigate." He gave a subtle look to his trusted aide, who departed on the errand. Unaware of the ruse, the emissary thought this worthless Grand Tutor truly weak and easily bullied, coldly laughing: "If the Grand Tutor feels unwell, he may retire first—" Just as he was about to continue presenting evidence, he saw Chen Ji's aide return, escorting two狼狈不堪的人 behind him.

text.content: "Your Majesty, these two are the contacts the Xuanwu Sect arranged at East Huamen Gate," Chen Ji's aide announced loudly. "We found tokens confirming their communication with the rebel forces outside the city, as well as..." He drew a token from his怀中. "A passage token from the Demonic Holy Sect!" At this declaration, the entire court erupted. The Xuanwu Sect and the Demonic Holy Sect were sworn enemies—how could they have secret dealings? The old emperor's gaze suddenly sharpened.

dialogue.content: Only then did Chen Ji slowly straighten up, as if that sickly demeanor had never existed. He surveyed the surroundings, his gaze finally landing on the Xuanwu Sect emissary's deathly pale face: "The honored emissary just spoke of someone committing treason against the nation. This Grand Tutor is curious—why would a Demonic Holy Sect token appear on Xuanwu Sect personnel?" His voice remained gentle, yet every word cut to the heart. "Could it be... that someone is crying thief while being the thief?"

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect emissary has been driven into a dead end. How will Chen Ji conclude this court game?

choices.description: Seize the victory and pursue relentlessly, publicly exposing the Xuanwu Sect's entire conspiracy plan, leaving the emissary humiliated and unable to turn the tide.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more traces of the scheme.
choices.visible_reward: The Xuanwu Sect loses face completely; reputation in court rises dramatically.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji paced forward, his voice not loud but clearly carrying through the hall: "Your Eminences may not be aware that the Xuanwu Sect secretly allied with the Demonic Holy Sect three days ago—they plan to use this 'treason' charge to eliminate loyal ministers around the Crown Prince, then install a puppet ruler obedient to their commands." He withdrew several secret letters from his sleeve. "This is ironclad evidence."

text.content: The Xuanwu Sect emissary's face turned ashen. He never imagined this worthless Grand Tutor actually held such lethal leverage. The old emperor's dragon face blazed with rage: "The Xuanwu Sect dares collude with the Demonic Path! Guards, seize this emissary for thorough investigation!" The emissary collapsed limply, begging repeatedly, but was dragged away by the imperial guards.

choices.description: Stop at the appropriate moment, exposing only partial evidence, leaving a lifeline for the Xuanwu Sect—demonstrating generosity while making them indebted.
choices.visible_reward: Garner leverage over the Xuanwu Sect for future gradual schemes.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may harbor resentment and bide their time for revenge.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shifted his approach, addressing the old emperor: "Your Majesty, please quell your anger. Perhaps someone within the Xuanwu Sect was driven by selfish greed and acted against the sect's true intentions." He glanced meaningfully at the emissary. "What does the honored emissary think?" The emissary felt as though granted amnesty, nodding repeatedly: "The Grand Tutor's insight is clear! It must be someone impersonating the Xuanwu Sect to commit such great treachery!"

text.content: Chen Ji casually tucked those secret letters into his sleeve, as if merely putting away a few irrelevant sheets of paper. The ministers of the court watched this, all deeply alarmed—this seemingly frail Grand Tutor clearly held a blade that could decapitate the Xuanwu Sect at any moment, yet chose to sheathe it.

choices.description: Transfer the evidence to the Crown Prince for handling, using the Crown Prince's hand to suppress the Xuanwu Sect—avoiding suspicion while making the Crown Prince deeply indebted.
choices.visible_cost: The credit belongs to the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince's faction grew even more solid, while Xuanwu Sect's hatred was directed at the Crown Prince rather than Chen Ji
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince's wings are growing stronger, which may become difficult to fully control
choices.process_label: use others as pawns, follow the flow

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to face the Crown Prince and bowed, saying: 'Your Highness, this matter concerns the foundation of the nation. Your servant dares not decide unilaterally.' He presented the secret letter with both hands. 'How to handle this is entirely for Your Highness to determine.' The Crown Prince took the letter, gazing complexly at this Grand Tutor he had never been able to see through. An indescribable emotion surged in his heart—this was clearly a monumental achievement, yet he was offering it to others?

text.content: The Crown Prince drew a deep breath and said in a grave voice: 'The evidence of Xuanwu Sect's collusion with the Demonic Path is conclusive. Seize the envoy for now—I will personally write to the Xuanwu Sect Master for an explanation!' At these words, the Xuanwu Sect envoy's face turned ashen. When the Crown Prince himself entered the field, even a sect with great abilities would struggle to escape unscathed. As he was dragged away, his resentful gaze fixed intently on Chen Ji.

The court session dispersed, leaving only the Crown Prince and Chen Ji in the hall. The Crown Prince dismissed his attendants and gazed at this unfathomable Grand Tutor, suddenly rising to bow deeply: 'Your great talent, sir... only today did I realize.' His voice trembled slightly, 'Where did you obtain those evidence? I always thought you were merely...' He didn't finish, but the word 'waste' was self-evident.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji supported the Crown Prince's arm and helped him up, his smile gentle as spring breeze: 'Your Highness, there's no need for such courtesy. Your servant merely shielded Your Highness from some storms.' He shifted topics, 'But Your Highness's earlier handling was appropriate—swift and decisive, befitting a Crown Prince.' This was beautifully said, expressing loyalty while flattering the other. A flicker of emotion appeared in the Crown Prince's eyes.

text.content: 'Rest assured, sir.' The Crown Prince lowered his voice, his expression resolute. 'I will remember today's matter. Should you have any needs in the future, do not hesitate to ask.' He paused, a trace of ruthlessness flickering in his eyes. 'How dare Xuanwu Sect collude with the Demonic Path—I will make them pay!' Chen Ji nodded slightly, but in his heart he was calculating—the Crown Prince's determination was even stronger than he had anticipated. This chess piece was becoming increasingly useful.

choice.prompt: The court session had ended, and Chen Ji needed to plan his next move. How should he capitalize on this great victory?

choices.description: While the Crown Prince's trust is at its peak, secretly place trusted followers to fill the power vacuum left by Xuanwu Sect in court
choices.visible_cost: Actions too bold may arouse suspicion
choices.risk_hint: May provoke backlash from other factions
choices.process_label: strike while iron is hot, expand influence

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the Grand Tutor's residence and immediately wrote several secret letters to his confidants: 'Those old friends of Xuanwu Sect in the Ministry of Revenue must be living in fear.' A slight smile curved his lips. 'Go tell them that as long as they are willing to serve the Crown Prince, this Grand Tutor can ensure their safety.' The confidant departed with the orders. Chen Ji gazed at the darkening sky outside the window, a satisfied gleam flickering in his eyes—on the chessboard, several more usable pieces had been added.

choices.description: Cash in the gains and pretend to continue being the useless Grand Tutor, letting everyone lower their guard
choices.visible_reward: Continue maintaining the persona, reducing the risk of exposure
choices.risk_hint: May cause the Crown Prince to think the Grand Tutor is overly cautious
choices.process_label: hide true strength, retreat to advance

text.content: After dismissing his confidants, Chen Ji sat alone in the study. He changed out of his court attire and draped on that faded old robe, rehearsing a servile expression before the bronze mirror—as if the earlier sharpness had never existed. 'A waste should look like a waste.' He murmured to himself, a self-mocking smile appearing at the corner of his mouth. The essence of the Tianji Record flowed through his body, and his foresight ability slowly recovered—he needed rest.

choices.description: Secretly send someone to contact Xuanwu Sect, hinting that there may be room for negotiation, planting seeds for future exploitation
choices.visible_reward: Xuanwu Sect will owe a favor, which can be gradually exploited in the future
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince finds out, it may create discord.

dialogue.content: Late at night when all was quiet, Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment. The runes on it flickered faintly. He picked up his brush and wrote down several names—those ministers who had spoken for the Xuanwu Sect in court today. 'You thought this Grand Preceptor would root out the weeds to prevent future trouble?' He smiled faintly. 'How naive.' A slip of paper was secretly sent out of the mansion, bearing eight characters: 'Leave room for maneuver, await the opportune moment.'

text.content: What Chen Ji did not know was that beyond the nine heavens, a pair of invisible eyes were gazing at him through the Void. 'Interesting.' The will of the Heavenly Eye was like a wisp of cold smoke. 'This ant believes he is playing chess, yet he does not realize he is merely a piece on my board.' Its voice carried no emotion, yet it was permeated with a chilling certainty. 'The wielder of the Tianji Record... the eighth one.'

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. Chen Ji frowned and looked down, only to see the originally blurry runes gradually becoming clear—the knowledge sealed within Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was slowly unsealing. His heart stirred—could today's court affairs have triggered some condition?

dialogue.content: An aged voice emerged from the fragment: 'Young man, you've done well.' Mo Xiansheng's voice remained ethereal, yet carried more praise. 'Court politics are merely an appetizer; the real battle lies ahead. The Xuanwu Sect will not let this go. Their Sect Master... had some history with this old man.' The words cut off abruptly, as if deliberately leaving a suspense.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the newly emerging runes on the fragment, a complex emotion rising in his heart. This mysterious guardian of a remnant soul always threw out cryptic hints at crucial moments, yet never spoke plainly. 'Master, how many secrets do you still have hidden?' he asked quietly. However, what answered him was only silence, as that ancient aura had sunk back into the depths of the fragment.

A night owl's cry suddenly came through the window, bringing Chen Ji back to his senses. He put away the Tianji Record Fragment and cast his gaze toward the deep night outside the window. 'I won the first round today, but the Xuanwu Sect's retaliation will only grow more ferocious.' he murmured to himself. 'As for the Crown Prince... he is becoming more and more dependent on me. This is not a bad thing, but I cannot let him think he can manipulate me at will.'

choice.prompt: It was late at night, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to arrange things for tomorrow. Facing the approaching storm, what stance would he choose to respond with?

choices.description: Dispatch people to investigate the Xuanwu Sect's internal affairs, eliminate threats preemptively by nipping them in the bud
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, transform passive into active
choices.risk_hint: Beat the grass to startle the snake

text.content: Chen Ji spent the night writing several letters, dispatching the mansion's undercover agents to various locations. 'The Xuanwu Sect has three hidden strongholds in Jiangnan, and a secret force near the capital—' He circled several positions on a map. 'Keep a close eye on them. If they dare to move, we move first.' The undercover agents received their orders and vanished into the night. Chen Ji lifted his teacup, a cold smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.

choices.description: Hold position, wait for the Xuanwu Sect to make their move and then counter accordingly, preserve strength and await the opportune moment
choices.visible_cost: May fall into a passive position
choices.visible_reward: Conserve energy and build strength, strike back when the opportunity arises
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may unite with more forces

text.content: Chen Ji closed the map and closed his eyes to rest. The foresight of the Tianji Record told him that the Xuanwu Sect's retaliation would arrive within three days, but he did not need to intercept it preemptively—because no matter what move they made, he had already positioned his counter-pieces on the chessboard. 'Let them come.' he said softly. 'This Grand Preceptor is feeling unwell today and wishes to rest properly.'

choices.description: Contact the Holy Sect's Saintess Ye Qing of the Demonic Path, have her spread false information to muddy the waters
choices.visible_cost: Incur a debt to Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: The situation becomes more chaotic, fish in troubled waters
choices.risk_hint: Association with the Demonic Path carries risks
choices.process_label: use their force, fish in troubled waters

dialogue.content: A jet-black jade slip quietly flew out of the Grand Tutor's residence and vanished into the night sky. Three days later, Ye Qing, thousands of miles away, received the news. A playful smile curved at the corner of her mouth: "Interesting, this Grand Tutor Chen certainly knows how to leverage others." She picked up her pen and wrote several lines on a slip of paper—a cipher only someone from the Demonic Path would understand, enough to make the Xuanwu Sect's "allies" uneasy and fearful.

text.content: The next morning, the area outside the Grand Tutor's residence suddenly became bustling. The Crown Prince's rewards arrived in an endless stream—gold, silver, jewels, rare medicinal herbs, even a sword inlaid with gold and jade. The imperial messenger eunuch said in a shrill voice: "His Highness says the Grand Tutor has toiled for the nation; this is merely a token of respect." The household servants' gazes toward Chen Ji had completely changed—when did this "useless Grand Tutor" become so favored?

Chen Ji maintained an expression of being overwhelmed with favor, repeatedly declining: "How could I dare accept this? This old minister is merely fulfilling his duty." He instructed the housekeeper to store the rewards in the treasury as he himself leisurely strolled back to the backyard. No one saw the slip of paper that fell from his sleeve, which read: "Plan proceeding smoothly, continue covert operations."

Yet beneath the surface of tranquility, hidden undercurrents stirred. Within the Xuanwu Sect's mountain gate, the news that their envoy had been escorted back triggered a major uproar. Sect Master Han Batian smashed the stone table beside him with a palm strike: "A mere useless Grand Tutor dares to humiliate the Xuanwu Sect's honor!" He looked around at those present. "Issue orders—all sect disciples are to fully consolidate. In three days... I will personally enter the capital!"

Meanwhile, the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment grew even more distinct. Chen Ji sat cross-legged, sensing the True Qi circulating slowly within his body—that was a blessing from Master Mo's remnant soul unlocking the second page of knowledge. "When soldiers come, we'll send generals to block them; when water flows, we'll use earth to contain it." He opened his eyes, his gaze profound and deep like an abyss. "Han Batian is coming? Then let this Grand Tutor see exactly what prowess the Xuanwu Sect's sect master truly possesses."

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shuddered violently. An aged voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: "Boy, be wary of Ling Yuan." Chen Ji's heart tightened—that name of the old sect master of the Tianqing Sect he hadn't heard in ages. Master Mo's voice drifted, solemn and grave: "There exists between him and Xuanwu Sect Master Han Batian a past unknown to all... In three days, perhaps there will be a change." As the voice faded, the fragment fell silent once more.

Chen Ji stared at the fragment in his hand, his brow furrowing slightly. He had never underestimated the name Ling Yuan—that old sect master who outwardly sheltered him yet harbored hidden malice, emerging in increasingly dangerous forms with each passing period. "Master, are you suggesting... that Ling Yuan will join forces with Han Batian?" The fragment gave no response, but Chen Ji had already gleaned the answer from that very silence. A cold smile crept across his face: "Interesting—this chess game grows more lively by the day."

Night fell; the Grand Tutor's residence was wrapped in profound silence. Chen Ji sat alone in his study, a massive chessboard spread open before him—密密麻麻标注着各方势力的棋子——天青宗、玄武宗、魔道圣宗、皇室 each piece meticulously marking the positions of various power factions. Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, the Demonic Holy Sect, even the imperial family—every piece was within his calculations. "Three days from now, the changing situation will reveal whose weakness shows first." He murmured softly, placing the chess piece in his hand—it landed precisely at the center of the board, right atop the piece bearing the characters "Xuanwu".
